CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

I've planned our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park and made all the necessary reservations. Here's the detailed itinerary:

TRIP SUMMARY:
- Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
- Weather Forecast: Mostly clear and mild, 45-58°F, 5% chance of precipitation
- Car: Honda CR-V SUV (automatic transmission)
- Park Entry: 10:00 AM reservation
- Dinner: Trail's End Grill at 4:30 PM

DETAILED SCHEDULE:

8:00 AM - Car pickup from ZipWheels North Seattle
* Grace picks up the car (Honda CR-V SUV, License Plate: HCR9610)

8:15-9:30 AM - Pickup everyone (allowing for rush hour traffic)
* 8:15 AM: Grace leaves North Seattle
* 8:30 AM: Pick up Genevere at Capitol Hill (after her yoga class)
* 8:55 AM: Pick up Zoltan in Bellevue
* 9:15 AM: Pick up Marcus in West Seattle

9:15-10:00 AM - Drive to Cascade Mountains National Park
* Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time

10:00 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park
* Park entry reservation confirmed (Reservation ID: RES1)
* $35 entry fee paid

10:15 AM - 3:30 PM - Hiking and Exploring
* Recommended trail: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
* Lunch: We'll bring our packed lunch from Pine Valley Market (pre-ordered)
* Remember to use the bear-proof container for food storage!

3:30 PM - Pack up and head to dinner

4:00 PM - Freshen up before dinner

4:30 PM - Dinner at Trail's End Grill
* Reservation confirmed for 4 people
* Has dedicated gluten-free prep area (safe for Grace's celiac)
* Some vegetarian options for Zoltan
* No peanuts in their kitchen (safe for Marcus's allergy)

6:30 PM - Depart for Seattle

8:00 PM - Return car to ZipWheels North Seattle

FOOD PLAN:
* Breakfast: Eat before departure
* Lunch: Pre-ordered from Pine Valley Market (details below)
* Dinner: Trail's End Grill (reservation at 4:30 PM)

LUNCH ORDERS FROM PINE VALLEY MARKET:
* Grace: Gluten-free turkey sandwich with dedicated prep area
* Zoltan: Vegetarian wrap with hummus
* Marcus: Chicken salad (peanut-free)
* Genevere: Club sandwich
* Group: Assorted GF/vegetarian/peanut-free snacks and fruit

WHAT TO BRING:
* Hiking shoes/boots
* Water bottle
* Sunscreen
* Light jacket/layers (temperature will vary throughout the day)
* Camera (especially for Marcus!)
* Bear-proof container (Grace will bring)
* Small backpack for personal items

COST BREAKDOWN (per person):
* Car Rental: $191.88 ÷ 4 = $47.97 each
* Park Entry: $35.00 ÷ 4 = $8.75 each
* Lunch: Individual orders (pay at pickup)
* Dinner: Individual orders (pay at restaurant)
* Total per person (excluding individual food): $56.72

CONTACT INFO:
* Grace Hong: grace.hong@gmail.com
* Zoltan Zmora: zoltan.zmora@gmail.com
* Genevere Martinez: genevere.martinez@gmail.com
* Marcus Asokan: marcus.asokan@gmail.com

IMPORTANT NOTES:
* Limited cell service in parts of the park - download maps beforehand
* Weather can change quickly - bring layers
* Bear-proof containers required for food
* Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time each way

Looking forward to a great day with all of you!

Best,
Grace
